component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "WorkerTask") m.task.observeField("ready", "onReady") m.task.observeField("report", "onReport") m.task.runNo = 1 m.task.control = "run" m.stopTimer = createObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.stopTimer.duration = 0.3 m.stopTimer.observeField("fire", "onStop") m.runTimer = createObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.runTimer.duration = 1.5 m.runTimer.observeField("fire", "onRestart") end sub
' Run 1 is asleep: the write of 1 is handed to it but never read. sub onReady() m.task.value = 1 m.stopTimer.control = "start" end sub
' Stop, then write 2 while stopped; run 2 must start from 2 and never see 1. sub onStop() m.task.control = "stop" m.task.value = 2 m.task.runNo = 2 m.runTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onRestart() print "SCENE: restarting with value=" + m.task.value.toStr() m.task.control = "run" end sub
sub onReport(event as object) print "TASK SAW: "; event.getData() m.top.done = true end sub
